newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH INSURER PREMIUMS RISE TO CZK26.2BLN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH INSURER PREMIUMS RISE TO CZK26.2BLN.

text.p: Ceska Pojistovna a.s., the largest Czech insurer, saw the amount of premiums it collected in 1996 rise to 26.2 billion crowns from 23.5 billion in the previous year, the firm said in a statement on Monday.
It added that payments for claims in 1996 totalled 17.5 billion crowns, up from 16.95 billion in 1996.
The statement said that non-life insurance premiums accounted for the majority at 19.2 billion, while life insurance premiums accounted for the remaining 7.0 billion crowns.
Life insurance premiums in 1995 totalled 6.54 billion crowns, while non-life premiums were 16.94 billion.
